run.purpose: visualize every input to the repeated rollout-5 guidance loss

absolute_physics_target_pca.description: One PCA basis fitted jointly to every direct full-window and endpoint effective target latent across all five cases and six captured steps.
absolute_physics_target_pca.normalization: Each component maps zero to 128 and its global 99th absolute percentile to the display range.
absolute_physics_target_pca.temporal_expansion: Latent frame 0 is shown once; latent frames 1-12 are each held for four video frames.
